A '''rout''' was conducted at [[Tantara]] during the [[Waymancy Storm]]. It was the first known deployment of the [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic Rocket Jumpers]] and boosted [[Pulse-wave blaster|pulse-wave carbines]], which resulted in the routing of a [[Neshtab]]ine nest on the planet.
